title: IGNITION SWITCH MOUNTING
summary: Procedure for installing the ignition switch lock cylinder (key cylinder) into the lock housing on the steering column. The cylinder has no screws: it is retained by its own spring-loaded tab that snaps into a groove in the housing bore. No part numbers on this sheet; the lock cylinder is listed under UPC 1 (doors).

fastening.note: Retained by the cylinder's own spring-loaded tab (no separate fastener) popping into a groove in the housing bore; key on the lock cylinder sleeve aligns with the housing keyway; the cylinder's drive section engages the lock sector (part of the column assembly).

notes: Install lock cylinder: 1) With the key in the cylinder, hold the lock cylinder sleeve and turn the knob clockwise to its stop (viewed from the key end).
2) Insert the cylinder into the housing bore with the sleeve key aligned to the housing keyway; push in until the cylinder end touches the lock sector.
3) Keep light inward pressure and slowly turn the knob counterclockwise until the cylinder's drive section mates with the sector.
4) Push in until the spring-loaded tab pops into the groove in the bore. Pull outward to check retention; if it comes out, start again at step 1.
5) Check the cylinder turns freely, with free spring return from START to RUN.
A: FURNISHED BY FISHER BODY (lock cylinder sleeve).
notes_internal: No callout list, torques or revisions on this sheet. Title block heading partly obscured by hole punch ('LOCK CYLIN_ER'). Torque triangles empty; 'K191' printed sideways.
